Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the deep dive into Finlo's inference needs. When you have a moment, could you confirm the owners and target dates so we can lock the internal schedules on our side?

Key items in the attached MPA (high-level):
- Kickoff / scoping session (15–30m) — target owner: Ekta Rao
- Data & sample access (S3 access + sample dataset) — target owner: Samir Patel
- Security & compliance checklist (SOC 2 scoping, audit evidence) — target owner: Ashwin Reddy
- Pilot run (2 weeks) — target owner: Samir / Engineering

Attached: Finlo_Mutual_Action_Plan_20270315.pdf (draft).

Two asks:
1) Please confirm who from Finlo will own each line item above (names + email).
2) Do the proposed target dates look reasonable? If timing has shifted, tell us and we can re-prioritize.

If easier, we can do a quick 15-minute sync this week to confirm and sign off.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
